speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: Mind the step. It was always loose.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: I left the bread on the sill. Someone should take it in.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: Tell her I will be home before dark.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: That is my coat. I know that coat.

speaker: unfinished_borrower
text: Who let the dog out?

speaker: warden_guide
text: Stay close.

speaker: warden_trader
text: Not much today.

speaker: warden_auctioneer
text: Others left these. Name your price, or pay theirs.

speaker: warden_lookout
text: Keep your eyes open.

speaker: warden_appraiser
text: Bring me what you can't read.

speaker: warden_appraiser
text: Not enough gold for that one.

speaker: warden_appraiser
text: That one was worth the wait.

speaker: warden_guide
text: You carry the storm and swing it like a stick. Don't swing it. Throw it. It goes where you look.

speaker: warden_guide
text: You fell out of your line. So did I.

speaker: warden_guide
text: Between two moments there should be nothing. Now there is you. They will come for you.

speaker: warden_guide
text: You think you were born. You think yesterday happened. You only remember it.

speaker: warden_guide
text: A moment, then another, far apart. Each one remembers the last, so it feels like a life.

speaker: warden_guide
text: You are standing in the gap between two of them. I used to guard it. Now I get people out.

speaker: warden_guide
text: They did not make time. They learned to count it, and called that owning it.

speaker: warden_guide
text: No one should own the gap. Not them. Not me. Not you.

speaker: warden_guide
text: I mean to burn the ledger. Then no one is counted again.

speaker: warden_guide
text: At the Last Gate stands the Reckoner. It will put you back, and you will not remember you ever left.

speaker: warden_guide
text: Come back when you are stronger.

speaker: warden_guide
text: It counted you and came up short. Good.

speaker: warden_below
text: Everything that lands in the Hall runs down here in the end.

speaker: warden_below
text: What is left of a moment drips through the rock and pools in the dark. No one counts it.

speaker: warden_below
text: The things down here live on it. Nothing sent them. They are only hungry.

speaker: warden_below
text: At the bottom they burn what runs down, so nothing is left that they did not count.

speaker: warden_below
text: Meet me at the bottom of the caves. The ledger lies beyond the fire.

speaker: warden_below
text: This is as far as the hours run. Past here, they burn.

speaker: warden_below
text: Something is coming up the way. Stay behind me.

speaker: warden_below
text: It has not come for you.

speaker: warden_below
text: It has not forgotten me.

speaker: warden_below
text: More are coming. I will hold the way.

speaker: warden_below
text: Go now. Do not wait for me.

speaker: warden_below
text: It cannot keep what was never its own.

speaker: warden_below
text: Stay close.

speaker: timekeeper_gatekeeper
text: You are early. Everyone is early.

speaker: timekeeper_gatekeeper
text: Again. Slower this time.

speaker: timekeeper_gatekeeper
text: Hold still. Let me count you.

speaker: timekeeper_gatekeeper
text: Then the hour is yours.

speaker: timekeeper_reclaimer
text: You are early. Everyone is early.

speaker: timekeeper_reclaimer
text: There you are. We have looked for you a long time.

speaker: timekeeper_reclaimer
text: Then the hour is yours.

speaker: timekeeper_tallier
text: You were counted at the Gate, and came up short.

speaker: timekeeper_tallier
text: This is where the count is kept. We have all seen you coming.

speaker: timekeeper_tallier
text: You left the gold. We saw.

speaker: ledger_keeper
text: So you are the one too many. Stand there. I mean to be fair about this.

speaker: ledger_keeper
text: Order is a kindness. Without the count, anyone in the gap could walk into your life and change it.

speaker: ledger_keeper
text: This book is all that keeps them out of each other's moments.

speaker: ledger_keeper
text: Enough.

speaker: ledger_keeper
text: You broke the book, and you did not pick up the pen.

speaker: reeve
text: I kept their book longer than I can count. A strange thing for me to say.

speaker: reeve
text: I believed order was kinder than freedom. A gap that no one watches is a door anyone can walk through.

speaker: reeve
text: Then you stood in it, broke the book and reached for nothing. I was wrong about you. Perhaps I was wrong about everyone.

speaker: reeve
text: It was only this count's book. When your next moment comes, they will open another.

speaker: reeve
text: I will not keep it for them again.

speaker: reeve
text: The one with the lantern went into the fire below the caves.

speaker: reeve
text: Nothing that falls there is lost. It is only not counted.

speaker: reeve
text: The book had another column. The moments you walked into and left as you found them.

speaker: reeve
text: No one asked me to keep it. I kept it anyway. Take this.

speaker: reeve
text: Order or freedom. Ask me again next count.

speaker: journal
text: Do not.
